subject.title: fix(sessions): large histories no longer load entire transcripts

question: Should this PR wait for the promised exact-head installed v9-to-v10 migration and restart-pagination artifact before merge?
rationale: This is an automatic stored-data migration and synchronous projection rebuild; tests and summarized proof are strong supplemental evidence, but they do not show the final branch upgrading a real installed database without history, cursor, or availability regressions.

options.title: Require final installed proof
